messages:
maria_cs: quick flag — Helios ramped to ~1k daily active in staging and now seeing steady 429s during the first 10–15m of warmup. They say most requests succeed after 1–2 retries. Can we triage?

clara_helios: yep, they repro locally and in our staging. Using browser-sdk v1.4.2, ephemeral tokens minted per session (default flow). 429s start right after users land and we get a spike of preflight/checks.

aj-eng: thanks — likely preflight fanout + very short ephemeral token TTL. Can you paste the exact failing request headers (sanitized) and confirm whether the 429s are on /preflight or on /v1/chat endpoints?

clara_helios: sample from client logs (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.inference
Authorization: Bearer ephemeral_XYZ...
User-Agent: helios-web/1.4.2
X-Request-ID: 9a8b7c
Body: {"messages":[...], "max_tokens":256}
```
Status: 429 (retry-after: 1)

Also see many GET /v1/preflight 429s at the same time.

sophie_se: this reads like thousands of parallel preflights + ephemeral token churn. Browser SDK default creates an ephemeral per-tab flow, which can spike preflight traffic if many users open at once. Two quick mitigations: reduce preflight frequency (cache preflight result for 30–60s on the client) OR issue one ephemeral token per user session and reuse for N requests or time window.

aj-eng: additions: implement exponential backoff with jitter on 429s (initial 300ms, cap 5s) and avoid hard immediate retries from all clients. Also ensure HTTP/2 connection reuse — many short-lived connections drive extra load.

ben_oncall: fwiw, we saw identical pattern with Ember onboard last quarter. Short-term we can: 1) give a temporary preflight quota bump for tenant helios-id: H-427, 2) whitelist their staging IPs for 1–2 hours while they ramp, and 3) advise they roll out a staged ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Want me to open the quota bump?

maria_cs: yes please open the bump. I'll collect tenant id + staging IPs. Also scheduling a quick enablement call with Helios engineers in 30m.

clara_helios: thanks — tenant H-427. Staging egress IPs: 54.23.12.8/32 and 54.23.12.9/32. We can stagger rollout if you recommend.

aj-eng: noted. Two longer-term fixes we can recommend to customer: 1) increase ephemeral token TTL to 60s for session reuse (we can do this server-side for onboarding), 2) use token pooling: mint one ephemeral per user and reuse for background requests for X seconds, 3) move heavy background work to server-side ephemeral proxies (less fanout).

sophie_se: I'll draft a short client-side checklist for the call: reduce preflight frequency, enable http2 keepalive, add jittered backoff, reuse ephemeral tokens for 30–60s, staged rollout. Also include a code snippet for safe retry: 
```js
// exponential backoff with jitter
let retry = 0;
async function send(req){
  try{ return await fetch(req); }
  catch(e){
    if(retry++ > 5) throw e;
    await sleep(Math.min(5000, 100 * 2**retry) * (0.5 + Math.random()/2));
    return send(req);
  }
}
```

deploy-bot: notice: temporary preflight throttle-relief config queued (ticket #CS-9831) — will apply after oncall approval.

ben_oncall: approved. Applying temporary bump to preflight window for H-427 now. Monitoring dashboards for spikes — I'll keep an eye for anomalous retry storms.

maria_cs: great. Clara, during the call we’ll walk them through the checklist and ask them to stage the ramp. After that we can revert the quota bump. Any objections? :thumbsup:

clara_helios: :thumbsup: appreciate the fast help. We'll join the call in 10.

aj-eng: one more diagnostic ask: if you can, snapshot client-side telemetry showing preflight timestamps + token issue timestamps (client clock often causes duplicate preflight on tab restore). Send that into the ticket.

maria_cs: will collect and attach. Closing loop after call and we'll post a short postmortem note here with outcome and recommended defaults for future onboardings.

sophie_se: note for playbook: default ephemeral TTL for browser SDK should be 45–60s for initial ramp guidance, and onboarding checklist should include staged rollout + connection reuse. I'll add to the enablement doc.

ben_oncall: monitoring: I'm seeing 30% drop in preflight 429s already since applying bump. Will update if anything weird pops up.

maria_cs: thanks team, closing for now — will reopen if issues persist.
